entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Umayyad Caliphate, a political institution in Jordan during Early Islamic Jordan and Umayyad Desert Castles (629–661). Grew from Battle of Mu'tah — one of the first Muslim encounters with the Byzantine Empire. Led to the emergence of Muslim and Battle of Yarmouk — decisive Muslim victory ending Byzantine rule in the Levant.
